insight.question: Which provider has the highest appeal volume and what is its overturn rate?
insight._sql:
-- q1: Which provider has the highest appeal volume and what is its overturn rate?
SELECT
  `Provider_Name` AS `Provider Name`,
  COUNT(`Case Identifier`) AS `Total Appeals`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN `Determination` IN ('OVERTURNED','PARTIALLY OVERTURNED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Overturned Cases`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN `Case Status` = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Closed Cases`,
  ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN `Determination` IN ('OVERTURNED','PARTIALLY OVERTURNED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN `Case Status` = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0), 2) AS `Overturn Rate`
FROM `my_catalog`.`default`.`appeals_final`
GROUP BY `Provider_Name`
ORDER BY `Total Appeals` DESC, `Provider Name` ASC
LIMIT 1
